title: Loose note (memo, research log, ad-hoc record)
description: Store reference information that is not managed as a decision, implementation change or work item.

topic.description: A single label broader than tags, such as 'auth-flow' or 'perf-investigation'.

summary.description: A one- or two-sentence summary for people and agents reading the index.

expires.description: Expected obsolescence date, used to decide whether to transition the status to archived.

record_type.description: Record type in the dev-evidence history producer contract. Requires subject_paths when specified.

subject_paths.description: Repository-relative paths addressed by the record, aggregated into the dev-evidence history view.

outcome.description: A brief conclusion, such as refuted/confirmed for debugging or fixed/filed for a finding.
